decrypt-accepts-out-of-order-frame-seque.description: decrypt accepts a framed message whose frame sequence numbers are out of order

encrypt-stream-ignores-plaintext-length-.description: streamed encrypt encrypts a plaintext longer than the plaintext-length bound

decrypt-accepts-trailing-bytes-commit-ke.description: decrypt accepts trailing bytes appended after a valid ALG_AES_256_GCM_HKDF_SHA512_COMMIT_KEY message
decrypt accepts trailing bytes appended after a valid ALG_AES_256_GCM_HKDF_SHA512_COMMIT_KEY_ECDSA_P384 message

create-client-accepts-reserved-aws-kms-n.description: CreateClient accepts a Raw-AES keyring in the reserved aws-kms key namespace

default-frame-length-262144.description: the default frame length is 262144 where every other implementation defaults to 4096 (a default-value difference, not a validation bug)

encrypt-rejects-empty-encryption-context.description: encrypt rejects an encryption context entry whose value is the empty string ("All keys and values in encryption context must be non-empty"), though the message format permits a zero-length value

encrypt-accepts-reserved-prefix-encrypti.description: encrypt accepts an encryption-context key beginning with the reserved aws-crypto- prefix (other than aws-crypto-public-key); encrypt.md requires the operation to fail for any key beginning with aws-crypto-

encryption-context-value-length-capped-a.description: encrypt and decrypt reject an encryption-context value of 32767 bytes or longer ("All keys and values in encryption context must be shorter than 32767"), though the message format permits value lengths up to 65535

decrypt-accepts-signature-trailing-garba.description: decrypt accepts a footer whose signature field is the valid ECDSA signature with garbage appended and the signature length inflated to match; lenient signature parsing ignores the trailing bytes

encrypt-mishandles-proto-encryption-cont.description: a message encrypted with a __proto__ encryption-context key omits that key from the serialized header while still binding it into the data-key wrap, so no other implementation can decrypt it; the same-language round trip succeeds and masks it

encrypt-non-positive-frame-length-generi.description: encrypt of a non-positive frame length is rejected as a GenericServerError instead of the modeled ESDKClientError

raw-aes-reserved-namespace-rejected-as-e.description: CreateClient rejects a Raw-AES keyring in the reserved 'aws-kms' key namespace as an ESDKClientError instead of the framework GenericServerError. The native Rust server and the C++ shim currently build the Raw-AES keyring through the Dafny MPL, which surfaces this config-validation failure as an ESDK error rather than a framework error.

raw-aes-wrong-wrapping-key-length-reject.description: CreateClient rejects a Raw-AES wrapping key whose length does not match the wrapping suite as an ESDKClientError instead of the framework GenericServerError. The native Rust server and the C++ shim currently build the Raw-AES keyring through the Dafny MPL, which surfaces this config-validation failure as an ESDK error rather than a framework error.

esdk-client-error-empty-message.description: an ESDK failure surfaces as an ESDKClientError with an empty message instead of the forwarded ESDK exception message
